name: Deep Amazon Expedition
description: The Carnival Ghost coordinates trade across South America, but deep Amazon settlements have gone silent. She needs a scout to go in and find out what happened before she sends the next trade caravan.

stages.name: Enter the Amazon
stages.description: Strike northwest from Rio into the deep Amazon basin. The Carnival Ghost's last known contact with the silent settlements was three months ago.

stages.name: Find the Silent Settlements
stages.description: Locate the three settlements that have stopped responding to the Carnival Ghost's traders. The jungle has reclaimed much of the old trail network.

stages.name: Determine What Happened
stages.description: Investigate the settlements — survivors, evidence, or absence — and return a full report to the Carnival Ghost before the next trade caravan departs.
